pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed dark brown regions with jagged/serrated edge gradients. Geometric shapes are predominantly stellate on the neck and transition to more blocky, irregular polygons on the upper flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored interstitial pathways. The topology is characterized by frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes with relatively uniform pixel thickness between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous dark brown mane exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck and shoulder.
